reviews.title: Broke my faith
reviews.text: I didnt know how many stars to give this to be honest. Im not sure how much i should trust in apps that use ai but alls i can say is that, given my life experiences, the app has solidify my belief that god does not exist. I even started to realise that here we are blindly believing in a faith/book that was created thousands of years ago. We blindly believe in the testimonies of people from those times yet…where is this god now? I may not have been a person of deep faith but i know enough to have believed in him for 40 years of my life. Now i have to deal with the trauma of realising that i was stupid to have trusted so blindly. We are misled by faith and it will now take one heck of a miracle for me to believe in this god again.
